rows.label: tlk70000047_01_msg0001
rows.name:
To reach the palace, follow those
stairs up. It will be on your left.

rows.label: tlk70000047_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Oh? You are not asking the way,
but about the girl's condition?

rows.label: tlk70000047_01_msg0003
rows.name:
That's my daughter, Furia. She's had a
serious illness for years, and it
seems very difficult to treat.

rows.label: tlk70000047_01_msg0004
rows.name:
The doctor says it's a difficult
disease with no effective medicine
here in Iira...

rows.label: tlk70000047_01_msg0005
rows.name: Sigh... What am I supposed to do...
